title: Retrieval Qualification
motivation: I3.14a validated the retrieval ladder as development evidence. Q3_RERANKED achieved RecallAll=0.82 vs Q0_BM25=0.60. Before freezing Q3 as production infrastructure, reproduce on a fresh query/task split with retrieval-only metrics (no LLM).
scope: Retrieval only. No A1, R1, MDSG, T2, or LLM involvement.

frozen_artifacts.task_corpus: I3.13 150-task corpus (seed=42, 25 per category, same-domain evidence)
frozen_artifacts.required_chunk_ids: passage IDs for evidence with retrieved=True
frozen_artifacts.chunking: one chunk per passage, no splitting

retrievers.Q1_DENSE: BGE-small-en-v1.5 (revision 5c38ec7c405ec4b44b94cc5a9bb96e735b38267a, pooling=cls, normalize=True, dim=384, max_seq=512, query_prefix='Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ')
retrievers.Q2_HYBRID: BM25 + BGE-small, reciprocal rank fusion (RRF k=60), top_k=5
retrievers.Q3_RERANKED: Q2 hybrid candidate pool (top 20) + gte-reranker-modernbert-base, top_k=5

validation_split.method: The I3.13 task corpus (seed=42) serves as the qualification split. A future confirmation split (seed=43) will be used for clean reproduction.

success_criteria.freeze_decision: If primary passes, freeze Q3_RERANKED as production retrieval stack for I3.15+

forbidden: Involving A1, R1, MDSG, T2, or any LLM component
Tuning retriever hyperparameters after observing results
Using LLM-based retrieval or LLM-based reranking
